title: Walkable Rincón Paradise near Plaza & Beaches
description: ¡Bienvenidos a Casa Calle Sol! From the moment you arrive at our tropical paradise, we want you to feel the true warmth of Puerto Rican hospitality and melt into the rhythm of this beautiful pueblo. Nestled among lush greenery, this inviting, fully air-conditioned 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom first-floor home offers the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure.The spaceAn easy, one-kilometer walk brings you straight to the shores of Playa Doña Lala and Balneario de Rincón. To make your packing completely effortless, we provide beach towels, beach chairs, and a cooler. You can spend your days soaking up the sun or head down the beach to watch Rincón’s world-famous sunsets paint the sky in brilliant shades of orange and pink, it's an absolute must-do experience. If you love to surf, we are also just a short 7-minute drive from some of the best surfing beaches on the West Coast!The excitement continues just 300 meters away at the vibrant Rincón Town Plaza, a quick four-minute stroll from your door. La Plaza is the absolute best place to immerse yourself in local culture any day of the week:Thursdays | The Art Walk (Art Walk Rincón): Starting around 4:00 PM, local artisans gather to showcase handmade jewelry, art, and crafts. On the first Thursday of every month, you can also experience the powerful rhythms of traditional Bomba y Plena music and dance.Sundays | Farmer’s Market: From 7:00 AM to 12:00 PM, visit La Plaza for the freshest local produce, organic tropical fruits, vegetables, and local honey.Even outside of market days, Rincón is celebrated for its creative heartbeat, and you will love being steps from local art galleries, yoga studios, a print shop, unique boutiques, and souvenir shops perfect for finding a special keepsake.When it comes to dining and nightlife, everything you could want is right at your fingertips. Just a short walk away you can pick up warm Puerto Rican bread (un pan sobao) or indulge in sweet, flaky quesitos to pair with your morning café. From breakfast to late-night treats, the neighborhood is packed with incredible restaurants, lively bars, and cozy cafes. For evening fun, you can check out the neighborhood karaoke bar or billiards spot just down the street. For any other daily essentials, you are also just one block from a fantastic wine shop, pharmacies, and a fully stocked, 24-hour gas and convenience station.Inside, the home features a restful space for family and friends, offering two bedrooms with cozy queen-size beds and a third bedroom with two twin beds. The fully equipped kitchen gives you total flexibility to cook and enjoy meals at home. When the evening cools down, step out back to the private outdoor sitting area and light up the gas BBQ grill, with grilling tools and outdoor dining items provided.Guest accessGuests have full, private access to the entire first-floor apartment, the backyard outdoor sitting area, and the BBQ grill. Safe, off-street parking is also provided for your exclusive use in our private carport, giving you total peace of mind.Other things to noteTo ensure you have a seamless and welcoming arrival, we provide a starter supply of toiletries to get your vacation off to a relaxing start. When you are ready to unwind inside, the comfortable living room features a 55” smart TV with cable and high-speed internet, perfect for streaming your favorite shows.For your peace of mind, please note there are exterior security cameras positioned at the property's entry access points; these serve strictly as a deterrent and are not a monitored live feed.Getting Around & Airports: Because everything from grocery essentials and bakeries to world-class beaches, art galleries, and nightlife is within easy walking distance, this is one of the few places in Rincón where a rental car is truly optional! If you are flying in, our property is conveniently located:35 minutes from both Rafael Hernández Airport in Aguadilla (BQN) and Eugenio María de Hostos Airport in Mayagüez (MAZ)1.5 hours from Mercedita Airport in Ponce (PSE)2.5 hours from Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport in San Juan (SJU)
